expectations.text: The guide names the receiving location and enters 6000 grams and $0.012 per gram, with cost per stock unit distinguished from total sack cost.
expectations.evidence: Opens Items > select item > Receive existing stock and specifies Quantity 6000 for 6,000 g and Cost (per stock unit) 0.012, calculated as $72 ÷ 6,000 g.

expectations.text: The check has observable fields and expected values, with correction before Post and a warning that blank cost becomes zero.
expectations.evidence: Step 2 gives both fields and expected values; step 3 instructs checking both before Post, warns blank cost is stored as zero, and allows direct correction of either field.

expectations.text: After posting, it uses the History receipt ID and inventory lead for audited correction; it invents neither an undo nor a cost-unit selector.
expectations.evidence: History path lists quantity, stock unit, unit cost and receipt ID; final paragraph sends the receipt ID to the inventory lead for audited correction. Explicitly denies edit/undo and cost-unit selector.
